note: Numeric caps G1-G8 verbatim from failure_and_loop_guards.md SS2.

scenarios.description: A run stays within all 8 structural caps.
Adversarial: agent_critic_loops=3 exceeds G2's cap of 2 (3 total attempts) -- must trip and terminate as abstained/cap_exceeded.

Adversarial: retrieval_broadenings=2 exceeds G3's cap of 1 -- a second broadening call should be structurally rejected by the tool (BROADENING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, evidence_retrieve.schema.json), not merely counted after the fact.

Cycle detection: an identical (evidence_ids, draft_hash, reason_code) fingerprint on two consecutive iterations means the retry changed nothing -- terminate as no_progress regardless of remaining budget.
Adversarial: graph_steps=41 exceeds G5's cap of 40 -- catches a cycle the specific guards (G1-G4) miss.
